name: Yuya
source:
Mysterious Illuminator who knows a lot about Noctuary.

[spoiler]The fortune-teller in the Main Beacon's market, self-proclaimed as a deity, speaks ambiguously and seems to enjoy playing tricks on others.[/spoiler]
